Thanks to Trump and Republicans’ Big Bad Betrayal and their $186 BILLION cut to SNAP, more than 70,000 people will die. 

Instead of pouring billions of dollars into Trump’s illegal war with Iran, we should be helping our neighbors.

Yesterday, Donald Trump called mail-in voting “cheating.”

But he literally just VOTED BY MAIL in a Florida special election happening today.

The hypocrisy is staggering. He actively wants to stop people from voting who don’t support Republicans.




Acyn (@Acyn)

Trump: It was brought to my attention today that we’re the only country that does mail in voting. I call it mail in cheating.

Video
  


Community note: 34 countries permit mail in voting pbs.org/newshour/amp/p…



— https://nitter.n

Enough money for forever wars.
Enough money for more bombs.
Enough money for ICE in our airports.

But never enough for health care, childcare, or feeding hungry families.

Thanks, Republicans.

During Eid, a drone attack on a major hospital in Sudan killed at least 64 people, including children, nurses, and a doctor.

This is a catastrophic humanitarian crisis. The United States must use our leverage to stop these atrocities and help save lives.

IDF advances in Lebanon have killed over 1,000 people, including over 100 children, and displaced almost a quarter of Lebanon’s population. These indiscriminate killings and the targeting of civilian infrastructure must stop.
bbc.com/news/articles/cy91j9…

Trump wants to spend $200 billion of taxpayer money on an illegal war rather than ensuring every American has food, health care, and an education.

It’s absolutely shameful.

Video

Read part of a statement from AFGE’s president, the union for TSA agents.

ICE is not helping TSA. It is creating more unnecessary chaos and confusion.

Trump's lawless ICE creates nothing but chaos and are completely untrained to conduct airport security.

Democrats are ready to fund TSA without giving ICE a blank check. Republicans are blocking it.

ICE needs to get the hell out of our airports NOW.
Medicare for All would provide comprehensive, quality health care to every American. (6/6)
Republicans want unlimited taxpayer dollars for war, but nothing for your health care. (4/6)
Republicans have since taken an axe to health care. Our system is broken. (3/6)
The Affordable Care Act expanded coverage and protected patients with pre-existing conditions. (2/6)
16 years ago, the Affordable Care Act was signed into law. Let’s talk about it. 🧵
Trump wants to send ICE agents to US airports. This will not make any of us safer. Read my full statement.
We have to stop Trump’s illegal war.

This week, I joined the Main Street Alliance Summit for a great roundtable discussion about policies that would help small businesses and our nation’s care infrastructure.

We need universal childcare, paid leave, and Medicare for All!

Find a crime. Blame an immigrant. Make people deportable. Deny basic due process. Rinse and repeat.

That is Republicans' favorite type of bill.

Video

Trump’s illegal war in Iran is making life more expensive. 

It needs to end. Now.
